answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Refundable entry stake: each identity locks 75 POA that vests back in slices across 11 epochs, only while its grading record stays clean; one confirmed junk verdict freezes the remainder. Running 740 fakes locks 55500 POA for months. A frozen treasury earns nothing while the farm waits for its vesting. What carries the jade here is verification, the basalt of cost is what stops the farm, and the vault of the record keeps every claim checkable. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
